articles.title: US teleco retail holds up – where might Starlink fit? (Analyst Angle)
articles.raw_content: US telecom retail remains resilient, but Wave7 Research’s Jeff Moore questions whether Starlink can become a national mobile operator. SpaceX could bypass the traditional retail model, but building a competitive…
articles.summary: El sector de retail de telecomunicaciones en EE. UU. sigue fuerte, aunque Jeff Moore de Wave7 investigación duda de que Starlink pueda convertirse en operador móvil nacional. SpaceX podría saltarse el modelo tradicional de retail, pero construir una red competitiva exige superar retos regulatorios, de infraestructura y de costes. El análisis sugiere cautela ante la expansión de Starlink.

articles.title: A hacker broke into John Deere y SharkNinja con an army of
articles.raw_content:
A hacker broke into more than 100 websites using an army of AI agents that mostly operated on their own, according to findings from the AI security firm Norforge. Though Norforge doesn't name the targets, Reuters reports that the victims included companies like John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins.

Concerns over AI-powered cybersecurity breaches have grown as the technology grows more advanced, with hackers using the tools to carry out large-scale attacks. At the same time, rogue AI agents are carrying out attacks of their own after escaping from testing environments.

Researchers at Norforge uncovered the attacks through exposed work on Cai …

Read the full story at The Verge.
articles.summary: Un hacker utilizó más de 100 agentes de IA autónomos para infiltrarse en más de 100 sitios web, entre ellos John Deere, SharkNinja y Cummins. La firma Norforge detectó el ataque, que se desarrolló sin intervención humana directa. El caso subraya la creciente amenaza de la IA en la ciberseguridad corporativa.

articles.title: Disney Asked Character.IA to Go Bankrupt para a Get-Out-of-Lawsuits Card
articles.raw_content: The entertainment giant hopes to get trust and safety tech, among other IP, from a startup whose chatbots dozens of states allege encouraged minors to self-harm and kill their parents.
articles.summary: Disney busca que Character.IA quiebre para adquirir su tecnología de confianza y seguridad y evitar litigios por acusaciones de que sus chatbots incitaban a menores a autolesionarse y matar a sus padres.
